# The Solo Kitchen & Bar

> The Solo Kitchen & Bar is a premier Mediterranean restaurant located in Museum Gardens, Cambridge Heath Road, London E2 9PA, in the heart of East London (near Bethnal Green, Hackney and Shoreditch). We serve authentic Turkish, Greek, Italian and Middle Eastern cuisine with vibrant Mediterranean flavours, all-day breakfast and brunch, signature cocktails, rooftop dining, and.

## Quick Facts

- **Name:** The Solo Kitchen & Bar
- **Location:** Museum Gardens, Cambridge Heath Road, London E2 9PA, United Kingdom
- **Area:** East London (Bethnal Green / Hackney area)
- **Phone:** +44 20 8014 2656
- **Email:** info@thesolo.co.uk
- **Website:** https://www.thesolo.co.uk
- **Cuisine:** Mediterranean, Turkish, Greek, Italian, Middle Eastern
- **Price range:** ££ (mid-range)
- **Atmosphere:** Family-friendly, casual smart dress code

## Opening Hours

- Monday – Thursday: 10:00 AM – 11:30 PM
- Friday: 10:00 AM – 12:30 AM
- Saturday: 10:00 AM – 12:30 AM
- Sunday: 10:00 AM – 11:30 PM

Breakfast & Brunch menu is served daily from 10:00 AM until 3:00 PM.
À La Carte menu is served daily from 12:00 PM to 10:00 PM.

## What Makes The Solo Kitchen & Bar Special

- **Rooftop Terrace:** Panoramic views of London with outdoor seating
- **Private Dining & Events:** Hosting groups from 6 to 200+ guests for birthdays, weddings, corporate events and celebrations
- **Cocktail Bar:** Extensive cocktail menu and curated drinks list
- **Multiple Menus:** Breakfast & Brunch, À La Carte, Drinks, BBQ Party, Party Sharing Platter, Party Drinks Package
- **Dietary Options:** Vegetarian and vegan options available
- **Accessibility:** Wheelchair accessible, free WiFi, family friendly

## Special Offers

- **20% Blue Light Card discount** for NHS staff, emergency services, armed forces, teachers and social care workers (verify card on arrival)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Where is The Solo Kitchen & Bar located?**
Museum Gardens, Cambridge Heath Road, London E2 9PA, in East London near Bethnal Green.

**What type of cuisine does The Solo Kitchen & Bar serve?**
Authentic Mediterranean cuisine with Turkish, Greek, Italian and Middle Eastern influences. We offer breakfast and brunch, à la carte dining, sharing platters, signature cocktails and an extensive drinks list.

**What are the opening hours?**
Monday–Thursday 10:00 AM – 11:30 PM, Friday/Saturday 10:00 AM – 12:30 AM, Sunday 10:00 AM – 11:30 PM.

**Does The Solo Kitchen & Bar offer a Blue Light Card discount?**
Yes, we offer a 20% discount for Blue Light Card holders.

**Does The Solo Kitchen & Bar have a rooftop?**
Yes, we have a beautiful rooftop terrace with panoramic views.

**Can I host a private event at The Solo Kitchen & Bar?**
Yes, we offer private dining for groups from 6 to 200+ guests. Contact us for event bookings.

**Is The Solo Kitchen & Bar family-friendly?**
Yes, we welcome guests of all ages with a casual smart dress code.

**Does The Solo Kitchen & Bar serve breakfast all day?**
Breakfast & Brunch is served from 10:00 AM until 3:00 PM daily.
